questions.question: After the LORD struck down every firstborn male in Egypt, what was heard across the land?
On the night the firstborn of Egypt died, what did Pharaoh tell Moses and Aaron?

answers.text: Get up and leave my people
Worship your God here in Egypt

questions.question: When the Israelites left Egypt and asked the Egyptians for silver, gold and clothing, why did the Egyptians give it?

answers.text: The LORD gave the people favor with them
Pharaoh ordered them to hand it over
Moses promised to pay them back later
